Two coins that have had legendary price swings that generate early investors with life-changing riches are Shiba Inu and XRP, whose values exploded in rather short times during their respective bull runs.  The price of XRP surged in 2017; SHIB repeated the same in 2021. The major question as we end the year is which token will do it in 2025.
 
XRP’s 2017 Bull Run: A 25,000% Price Explosion 
XRP gained unrivaled interest as its price jumped 25,000% in only five months. XRP reached a peak of about $1.50 by December, having traded in April for about $0.006. Several reasons were contributing to this explosive increase, though the main driving force came from crypto’s bull run that year, lifting the whole crypto market.
